column1: # xbios-chardev-r1.tsv -- DUMPBIOS, audit xbios-chardev (2026-10-28): the XBIOS
# character-device and keyboard inquiries -- Iorec, Rsconf, Keytbl, Kbdvbase,
# Kbrate, Bconmap -- with their boundary arguments, against EmuTOS 1a7484ab
# Added by the auditor (docs/audits/2026-10-28-xbios-chardev.md, section 5) as
# a table of its own, so bios-r1.tsv, its CRC and its references stay as they
# are.  Every row is inside the round-1 guard of tosdump/core/cases.c
# (call_policy): Iorec any device, Rsconf only all -1 or -2 then all -1,
# Keytbl and Kbrate only all -1, Kbdvbase, Bconmap any device but 6..9.  Form:
# What a pointer result points at (Iorec, Keytbl, Kbdvbase, Bconmap(-2)) is
# out of reach of a call table: PTR_RAM checks the address class only
# (TASK/TOOL11.md).  The audit measured the structures with a probe.
# -XBIOS-chardev-falcontc.  One table per round: frozen once measured.
# ---- XBIOS 0x0F Rsconf -- ULONG rsconf, bios/xbios.c:376, bios/serport.c:217-249
